title: 第1542章 跨跃十万年的联手第1541章 全力进攻法则之法本源
content_zh:
“这艘小船，你们继续留着用吧，失去它你们二人连在这里能否继续存活都会成为问题的。”
琉璃与雨红所驾驶的九龙，仍然挡在应无悔的前方（上面）。
昭光与吞天真君同一时间出现在应无悔周身，“应无悔，别放弃，有我们在，它是伤不到你的”昭光释放光影之门与吞天真君的无物不吞相融，形成一道充满漩涡异色的超极巨大光门，二人全力催动本命神通，这只手掌不管远近去看都只有数千米，但实际上是它在降临时就导致周遭的空间以及异能全部紊乱颠倒，哪怕是所见到的事物，亦是被附于了一层并非真实的海市蜃楼，这是想让人放松警惕障眼之法，然而昭光与吞天真君却是一眼看出。
应无悔道：“神尊，真君，是你们两个，你们是预判到他的行为了吗？有你们二人在，我就放心了”
“法则之罚为了灭杀你，连这种障眼法都使用出来了，换作其他天神，还不一定能够发现，它让你以为这次对你的攻击势头不大，可这法则之罚针对的目标一直都是你，又怎么只会只动用一部分的力量来灭杀你”吞天真君与昭光二人令自大的法则之罚手掌消失，落入到另一个空间，不过这个空间已经遭到手掌的全面破坏，它就像是剧烈腐蚀的强酸，二人所创造的空间被其如履平地。
昭光与吞天真君的空间手段，即将被横冲直撞无法阻挡的手掌冲破，他们预设位置，随时准备将它远远抛出。
“神尊，真君，我还是卡在最后一个阶段段，这最后一阶段的规则太不合理，哪有令一个还未达到界主的人，就面临这连界主也不一定能轻松应对的法则之法呢，况且前置条件就是解决法则之罚，否则这最后一步，就不可能完成啊”应无悔无可奈何道。
“开创界外之道，我与师兄也考虑到过一些突发情况的发生，开创一个门道，只有极小概率会引动灾劫，而且在一起的难易程度与本人实力挂钩，并不会超越本人实力太多，但眼下情况，是我之疏忽”昭光说道。
光门空间之内的手掌，搅得空间尽碎，随时会脱离昭光与吞天真君二人掌控，二人控制光门将其掷向青天世界边境，光门在中途迅速裂开，直到完全炸裂，巨大的手掌上穿插着无数道光剑与被噬咬的孔洞，纵使这样，它的气息依旧强盛。
“差一点就把它投到了由它自己所降下的法则之罚规定界线”吞天真君可惜道，若是这只巨大的手掌，直接对冲由它自身所设下的结界，说不定能破开结果，令天神们多一条活路，身处在这里的绝大多数天神都是身不由己，他们完全没有任何能力能够抗衡法则之罚，离开青天世界，就是他们唯一生路。
“师兄，我们只能赌上一把了，应无悔受到法则之罚的绝对镇压，无法移动，可正恰是令这只巨大手掌有无数次的进攻机会。”
“怎么赌，用蛮力，这完全行不通的，它如果再一次袭来，我没有把握在转移走它，在我们极限出手的空间内，连根本都没有损伤，也难怪无知己会葬身于它。现在它的核心正在遭受猛烈攻势，它们之间力量相连，应当会互有影响”吞天真君的无物不吞空间受到侵蚀，一半以上的空间遭到法罚之罚侵害而无法使用。
吞天真君使用一品法宝星海罗盘强化自身噬道战力，使用星海罗盘状态下，格外多一个无物不吞的等量无限空间，并可召唤星海世界强行化解攻势，解锁以星海为附加的强力杀招。
噬道界主级杀招——吞噬星空。
原先吞天真君所动用的是尊级，而达此级别杀需永久消耗噬道本源与海量道痕，海量道痕的数量会以“亿”为单位，所以吞天真君几乎不会动用此招，要支付的代价太大，他最多能动用此招，也不到十次，如今他不得不拼上一把。
昭光背后暗之魔法发动，不一样的暗色，仿佛极夜降世，昭光从光芒万丈的光躯，化为灰白暗色，这是他的光道力量的极致转换，灵感源自他本来就是一个来自神光星球天外之人，而且他还达到神光星球最为强大的大魔法师，堪称独步天下无敌于一整个神光星球，但是失去了一切，有这无敌的力量又如何，它换不回那些曾经所拥有的美好。
由昭光加入以“暗之魔法”为核心灵感创造而出的特殊帝品法宝——十宗罪，一一现世，分别是傲慢（戒之在骄，负重罚之）嫉妒（戒之在妒，缝眼罚之）愤怒（戒之在怒，镇压罚之）懒惰（戒之在惰，鞭策罚之）贪婪（戒之在贪，剜心罚之）暴食（戒之在馐，饥饿罚之）色欲（戒之在色，火焰罚之）谎言（戒之在言，雷电罚之）胆怯（戒之在怯，荆棘罚之）背叛（戒之在叛，恶魔罚之），一共十柄旷世奇特利刃，每一剑，都会让罪孽烟消云散，让邪恶无处遁形，让沉沦其中的生灵找回自我。
吞天真君见到这十柄纹路复杂，造型各异的瑰丽的锋利剑刃时，感到非常的吃惊，细看每一柄剑刃，都会看到一个个无边无际，笼罩视野之内的完全恶魔之影，利剑未出，便极具震慑力，此种法宝，绝非是单纯的暗道异能气息那么简单，还掺杂着强大无边的界外之力。
“师弟，你这法宝拥有一种超越这世界规则的美，正像我们如今所要突破的镇压”三天真君夸道。
“师兄，能用我原本力量解决的事情，我实在不屑于动用所谓的法宝法器，只是现在迫不得已了，以至于我不得不使用它，使用十宗罪，使用者会收到暗之魔法的吞噬，造成精神意志的失残或者灵魂的污染，以至于最后同黑暗彻底同化，但你师弟我已经达到了光道的顶点，十宗罪之力若能吞噬我，那也要把一整个八大界的光全部吃下吧，所以暗与光之间，我算是勉强达到平衡”昭光说道，十万年前他败于无知己，连此法宝都未能催动，相隔了十万年，在神光星球时完全掌握暗之魔法的昭光，仍旧如臂驱使。

“暗之魔法，师兄还是第一次听你这么说，也罢，如果你成为我师弟就太早让我知道你这奇特的其他能力，那么聪明如我，可能就会深究了，虽然那时候你师兄对于天外之人没有概念，若是受到这普罗天神大众的思想的影响，可能会因此伤了我们自己感情呢，还好我得知道你的身份时，早已大器晚成，小有作为，所以不论他人的疯言疯语，我也会力挺师弟你的”
“我们好像又回到了十万年前，那时与小师妹经历一次次绝境与死亡时刻交织的时刻，虽然我现在才知道是那老头一直在框骗我们，若是真真正正的，而非他的有意设计，那该有多好”吞天真君感慨道。
“师兄，我们经历的过程远比结果更重要，这是一段我们三人之间永恒的美好的记忆。”
“是啊，生命不在于长度，而在于宽度，活的久不如活的精彩，活的郁闷不如活的痛快，人生只有一次啊，呵呵，师兄我倒是好奇你那个世界了，若是我也出生在你们那里，我应该也会和你遇到吧，哈哈哈，当然是我有点做梦了。可师弟，我不管你的前世生活经历如何，你这一世总应该是弥补了你上一世许多的遗憾吧”
“嗯，很多……”
昭光与吞天真君二人真情流露道，他们的再一次相聚跨过十万年光阴，这种永远无法割舍的羁绊与情意，是世人无法想象的震撼，如今二人面对随时而来的随时导致致命的法则之罚，没有任何其他所想，只有再次联手的热血与喜悦。

"You should keep this small boat for use. Without it, it will be a problem for the two of you to survive here."
The Jiulong driven by Liuli and Yuhong is still blocking Ying Wuhui's front (above).
Zhaoguang and Lord Tuntian appeared around Ying Wuhui at the same time, "Ying Wugui, don't give up, as long as we are here, it can't hurt you." Zhaoguang released the light and shadow gate and merged with Lord Tuntian's swallowing of everything, forming a super huge light gate full of vortexes and different colors. The two of them tried their best to activate their natal magical powers, but this palm didn't care It is only a few kilometers from a distance, but in fact, when it arrives, it causes all the surrounding space and supernatural powers to become chaotic and upside down. Even the things they see are attached to a layer of mirage that is not real. This is a way to make people relax their vigilance and blindness, but Zhaoguang and Tuntianjun can see it at a glance.
Ying Wuhui said: "Honored God, True King, it's you two. Did you predict his behavior? With you two here, I feel relieved."
"In order to kill you, the Punishment of the Law has even used this blinding method. Other gods may not be able to detect it. It makes you think that the attack on you this time is not strong. But the target of the Punishment of the Law has always been you, so why can it only use one I will use all my strength to kill you." Lord Tuntian and Zhaoguang made the arrogant Law Punishment Palm disappear and fall into another space. However, this space has been completely destroyed by the palm. It is like a violently corrosive acid. The space created by the two of them was like walking on the ground.
The spatial means of Zhaoguang and Tun Tianzhen are about to be broken by the unstoppable palm of Rampage. They have preset positions and are ready to throw it far away at any time.
"Holy Lord, True Lord, I am still stuck in the last stage. The rules of this last stage are too unreasonable. How can a person who has not yet reached the realm master be faced with this law and method that even the realm master may not be able to deal with easily. Moreover, the prerequisite is to solve the punishment of the law, otherwise this last step will be impossible to complete." Ying Wuhui said helplessly.
"To create a way outside the realm, my senior brother and I have also considered the occurrence of some emergencies. There is only a very small chance that creating a way will cause disaster, and the difficulty of being together is linked to one's own strength, and it will not exceed one's own strength by much. But the current situation is due to my negligence," Zhaoguang said.
The palms in the light gate space were shattered into pieces, and they would be out of the control of Zhaoguang and Tuntianjun at any time. The two controlled the light gate and threw it towards the border of the blue sky world. The light gate quickly split in the middle until it completely exploded. The huge palm was interspersed with countless lightsabers and bitten holes. Even so, its aura was still strong.
"It almost threw it into the boundary set by the punishment of the law set by itself." Lord Tuntian said regretfully. If this huge palm directly opposed the barrier set by itself, it might be able to break the result and give the gods an extra way to survive. Most of the gods here are involuntarily. They have no ability to resist the punishment of the law. Leaving the world of Qingtian is their only way to survive.
"Brother, we can only take a gamble. Ying Wu regrets being absolutely suppressed by the punishment of the law and unable to move, but it is precisely this that gives this huge hand countless opportunities to attack."
"How to bet, use brute force, this is completely unworkable. If it attacks again, I am not sure that I can move it away. In the space within our limit, there is no damage at all. It is no wonder that Wuji will be buried in it. Now its core is under fierce attack, and the strength between them is connected. They should have an influence on each other." The nothing-swallowing space of Lord Tuntian has been eroded, and more than half of the space has been violated by legal punishment and cannot be used.
Lord Tuntian uses the first-grade magic weapon Xinghai Compass to strengthen his Devouring Dao combat power, and uses XinghaiIn the compass state, there is an extra equal amount of infinite space that cannot swallow anything. It can also summon the star sea world to forcibly resolve the offensive, and unlock powerful killing moves with the star sea as an additional bonus.
Devouring Dao Realm Master's ultimate move - Devouring the Starry Sky.
Originally, Lord Tuntian used the Supreme Level, but to reach this level, he needed to permanently consume the origin of the Devouring Dao and massive Dao marks. The number of massive Dao marks would be measured in "100 million", so Lord Tuntian would hardly use this move. The price to pay was too high. He could use this move less than ten times at most. Now he had to fight for it.
The magic of darkness behind Zhaoguang was activated, and a different dark color appeared, as if the polar night came to the world. Zhaoguang changed from a radiant body of light to a gray-white dark color. This was the ultimate transformation of his light power. The inspiration came from the fact that he was originally a person from the outer world of the divine light planet, and he was also the most powerful magician on the divine light planet. He was said to be the only one in the world and invincible in the entire divine light planet. But after losing everything, so what if this invincible power could not replace the beauty that he once had.
The special imperial magic weapon created by Zhaoguang and based on the core inspiration of "Dark Magic" - the ten deadly sins, one by one, appear in the world, namely arrogance (prevent it from arrogance, punish it with a heavy burden) Jealousy (prevent it from jealousy, punish it by slitting your eyes) Anger (prescribe it from anger, suppress it and punish it) Sloth (prevent it from laziness, punish it by whipping it) Greed (prevent it from greed, punish it by tearing out the heart) Gluttony (The warning lies in food, and hunger punishes it) Lust (the warning lies in lust, and fire punishes it) Lies (the warning lies in words, and thunder and lightning punishes it) Cowardice (the warning lies in timidity, and thorns punish it) Betrayal (the warning lies in rebellion, and the devil punishes it). There are ten unique and unique sharp blades in total. Each sword will make sin disappear, leave evil with nowhere to hide, and allow the creatures that have sunk in it to find themselves.
Lord Tun Tiantian was very surprised when he saw these ten magnificent sharp sword blades with complex lines and different shapes. If you look closely at each sword blade, you will see an endless shadow of a complete demon covering the field of vision. The sword is extremely frightening before it is released. This kind of magic weapon is by no means as simple as the aura of secret powers, but also mixed with powerful and boundless power from outside the world.
"Junior brother, your magic weapon has a beauty that transcends the rules of this world, just like the suppression we are trying to break through now," Santian Lord praised.
"Senior brother, I really don't bother to use the so-called magic weapon to solve things that can be solved with my original power. But now I have no choice but to use it. Using the Ten Deadly Sins, the user will be devoured by the magic of darkness, causing the disability of the spiritual will or the pollution of the soul, so that it will eventually be completely assimilated with the darkness. But you, junior brother, I have reached At the peak of the light path, if the power of the ten sins can devour me, then it will have to swallow all the light of the eight realms, so I can barely reach a balance between darkness and light." Zhaoguang said, he was defeated by Wuyou a hundred thousand years ago, and could not even activate this magic weapon. After a hundred thousand years, Zhaoguang, who fully mastered the magic of darkness when he was on the Shenguang Planet, is still able to control it like an arm.
"Dark magic, senior brother, this is the first time I heard you talk about it. Anyway, if you became my junior brother, it would be too early to let me know about your other strange abilities. If you are as smart as me, you might learn more about it, although at that time, your senior brother had no idea about people outside the world. , if we are influenced by the thoughts of the general gods, we may hurt our own feelings. Fortunately, when I need to know your identity, you are already a late bloomer and have made little achievements, so no matter other people's crazy words, I will support you, junior brother."
"We seem to have returned to a hundred thousand years ago, when I and my junior sister experienced desperate situations and moments of death. Although I now know that the old man has been deceiving us, it would be great if it was true and not his intentional design," Lord Tuntian said with emotion.
"Brother, the process we have experienced is far more important than the result.This is an eternal and beautiful memory between the three of us. "
"Yes, life is not about length, but width. A long life is not as good as a wonderful life, and a depressed life is not as good as a joyful life. You only have one life. Haha, senior brother, I am curious about your world. If I was also born in your place, I should also meet you, hahaha, of course I am a bit dreaming. But junior brother, I don’t care what your past life experience was, you should have made up for many regrets in your previous life in this life."
"Well, a lot..."
Zhaoguang and Tun Tianzhenjun revealed their true feelings. They reunited again across a hundred thousand years. This bond and affection that can never be broken away is a shock that the world can't imagine. Now that the two of them are facing the punishment of the law that may come at any time and may lead to fatal consequences at any time, they have nothing else to think about, only the passion and joy of joining forces again.
